title: Incorrect auto-envvar activation for empty envvar
detail: The condition uses `not envvar`, which is true for empty strings or empty lists, causing an auto-generated envvar to be added even when the user explicitly set an empty envvar. This breaks the intended behavior of suppressing envvar hints for empty values.
note: About the auto-envvar assignment above the planted line; the PR's own logic.

title: Incorrect handling of empty envvar in help
detail: When `envvar` is an empty string or empty list, `not envvar` is true, so the code attempts to add an empty envvar to the help output, resulting in `[env var: ]`. This contradicts the desired suppression of envvar hints for empty values.
note: Says the branch runs on an empty envvar, which the planted `not` does.

title: Incorrect header name normalization
detail: The logic sets every header name that is not exactly "content-type" to "Content-Type", overwriting the original header name and causing duplicate or lost headers.
note: Says every header but Content-Type is renamed, which the planted `!=` does.
